label: quality_attempt_identity
description: Hand-authored prospective cases for the quality_attempt_identity.v1 envelope. Each case pairs a full synthetic envelope with the structural '.quality_attempt_identity' errors a v1 validator is expected to raise. Valid cases must yield no errors. These cases were written by hand from the contract text and are never generated by calling the producer or validator. They prove structural consistency only: passing them does not prove backend existence, authenticity, statement identity, transaction identity, cancellation, rollback, or cleanup.

cases.name: captured_envelope_valid
cases.note: Captured state with an explicit-offset backend_start and the exact unobserved transaction object.

cases.name: captured_envelope_utc_valid
cases.note: Captured state with a Z timezone is accepted.

cases.name: unavailable_envelope_valid
cases.note: Unavailable state keeps session_identity null and capture_source none.

cases.name: missing_required_attempt_id
cases.note: attempt_id is a required envelope field.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity is missing required fields: attempt_id

cases.name: missing_required_capture_source
cases.note: capture_source is a required envelope field.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity is missing required fields: capture_source

cases.name: missing_required_session_identity
cases.note: session_identity is a required envelope field even when captured.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity is missing required fields: session_identity

cases.name: null_required_capture_state
cases.note: A null required field is not a valid enum member.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.capture_state must be one of: unavailable, captured

cases.name: wrong_schema_version
cases.note: Only v1 is defined.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.schema_version must be 1

cases.name: non_integer_schema_version
cases.note: schema_version must be a strict JSON integer; the numeric literal 1.0 parses as a non-integer number and is rejected even though it is numerically equal to 1.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.schema_version must be 1

cases.name: empty_attempt_id
cases.note: attempt_id must be non-empty.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.attempt_id must be a non-empty string

cases.name: captured_with_null_session_and_none_source
cases.note: captured requires a session object and the query_session source.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity must be an object when capture_state is 'captured'
quality_attempt_identity.capture_source must be 'query_session' when capture_state is 'captured'

cases.name: unavailable_with_session_identity
cases.note: unavailable requires session_identity null.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity must be null when capture_state is 'unavailable'

cases.name: unavailable_with_query_session_source
cases.note: unavailable requires capture_source none.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.capture_source must be 'none' when capture_state is 'unavailable'

cases.name: zero_backend_pid
cases.note: backend_pid must be positive.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity.backend_pid must be a positive integer

cases.name: negative_backend_pid
cases.note: backend_pid must be positive.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity.backend_pid must be a positive integer

cases.name: boolean_backend_pid
cases.note: A JSON boolean is not an integer pid.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity.backend_pid must be a positive integer

cases.name: timezone_less_backend_start
cases.note: backend_start must carry an explicit timezone.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity.backend_start must be an ISO-8601 date-time with an explicit timezone

cases.name: malformed_backend_start
cases.note: A non-ISO-8601 timestamp is rejected.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity.backend_start must be an ISO-8601 date-time with an explicit timezone

cases.name: wrong_transaction_state
cases.note: v1 transaction_identity is fixed to unobserved.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.transaction_identity.state must be 'unobserved'

cases.name: missing_transaction_state
cases.note: transaction_identity requires the state field.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.transaction_identity is missing required fields: state

cases.name: non_object_transaction_identity
cases.note: transaction_identity must be the exact unobserved object.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.transaction_identity must be an object

cases.name: extra_transaction_field
cases.note: No transaction id or cleanup claim is allowed in v1.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.transaction_identity must not include unsupported fields: transaction_id

cases.name: unsupported_top_level_cancelled
cases.note: A cancellation claim is not part of the identity contract.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity must not include unsupported fields: cancelled

cases.name: unsupported_top_level_rollback_completed
cases.note: A rollback claim is not part of the identity contract.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity must not include unsupported fields: rollback_completed

cases.name: unsupported_nested_backend_name
cases.note: A backend name is an unsupported nested session claim.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity.session_identity must not include unsupported fields: backend_name

cases.name: top_level_not_object
cases.note: The v1 envelope itself must be an object.
expected_errors: quality_attempt_identity must be an object
